title: Choosing an enrichment database
text: Curated biological pathways explicit gene memberships. Examples: hallmark, reactome, kegg_legacy, kegg_medicus, wikipathways, biocarta, pid. Use answer question “biological process shifting?”. Hallmark smallest collection (50 sets) gives fast first pass. Reactome KEGG_MEDICUS larger granular; expect results redundancy. Sub-choices matter. Hallmark sets deliberately broad (e.g. HALLMARK_OXIDATIVE_PHOSPHORYLATION 200 genes). Reactome breaks biology hierarchy “Metabolism” “Respiratory electron transport” “Complex biogenesis”, gene-set sizes thousand twenty. KEGG_LEGACY pre-2024 KEGG release; KEGG_MEDICUS redesigned 2024 collection cleaner network logic. WikiPathways skews toward community-curated metabolism signalling. BioCarta sets small, old, rarely right primary source useful cross-reference. PID covers cancer-relevant signalling specifically.

title: Choosing an enrichment database
text: Controlled vocabulary trees Gene Ontology HPO projects. Examples: go_bp, go_cc, go_mf, hpo. Use fine-grained term enrichment want drill specific functional axis. Expect heavy parent-child redundancy: GO_BP can return 30 enriched terms describe process different depths. Pair ev_collapse() (see vignette("pathway-dedup")) plotting. three GO branches answer different questions. GO_BP describes processes (“response oxidative stress”). GO_CC describes compartments (“mitochondrial inner membrane”). GO_MF describes molecular activities (“ATP-binding”). proteomics aging study, GO_BP usually carries headline biology; GO_CC natural follow-localization changes suspected; GO_MF best reserved biochemistry-heavy studies (enzyme classes, transporter families). HPO human-links genes clinical phenotypes; use aging signature overlaps known disease phenotype set.

title: Choosing an enrichment database
text: Subcellular localization sets. Examples: mitocarta3, hpa_subcellular, uniprot_subcellular. Use question “cellular compartment affected?”. MitoCarta3 149 curated mitochondrial sub-pathways top master mitochondrial gene list. HPA UniProt cover rest cell. MitoCarta3 strongest organelle source mitochondrial work human, mouse, rat. sub-pathways resolve OXPHOS complexes individually, separate matrix intermembrane space, split beta-oxidation chain length. HPA_subcellular comes Human Protein Atlas immunofluorescence atlas gives compartment calls backed image evidence. UniProt_subcellular broader species coverage coarser; pulls keyword annotations SwissProt TrEMBL.

title: Choosing an enrichment database
text: Signature sets sorted cell populations. Examples: immunesigdb (MSigDB C7), cell_type_sig (MSigDB C8). Use tissue-mixing questions: bulk muscle biopsy contains satellite cells, immune infiltrate, endothelium, strong enrichment one signatures often points composition shift rather per-cell regulation.

title: Choosing an enrichment database
text: TF miRNA target sets. Examples: tft_gtrd, mirdb. Use ask “driven specific transcription factor?”. GTRD built ChIP-seq data gives binding-based view; miRDB gives miRNA seed-match prediction. Treat results hypothesis-generating.

text: Disease-gene associations. Examples: disgenet, opentargets_disease. Use disease overlap questions: aging muscle proteome share genes sarcopenia type-2 diabetes? Read caution. what: Why is my ring plot empty?
title: FAQ
text: Four likely causes. classic one wrong ranking statistic. GSEA needs signed score - -regulated genes sit opposite ends ranked list (Subramanian et al. 2005; Reimand et al. 2019). Ranking unsigned pi-score collapses everything one tail yields near-empty rings. package defaults rank_by = "signed_p" (sign(logFC) * -log10(P)) now refuses unsigned pi-score ev_unsigned_ranking error rather silently mis-ranking. see error, drop rank_by override use default. See vignette("scoring") full explanation. Second, pathways passed enrich_padj filter. default 0.05, strict small contrast small fixture. Inspect padj distribution figure object: smallest padj 0.05, raise cutoff: Third, gene symbols match database species. msigdbr collections key human symbols species = "human", mouse symbols "mouse", . input rat symbols passed species = "human", overlap empty construction. Fourth, pathways dropped ev_collapse(). Loosen dedup cutoff passing higher value dedup list: cutoff close 1 keeps almost everything. ring still fills, original cutoff eating real biology; stays empty, issue upstream dedup.
